department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants: April 15 for Fall (September) 2027 entry; July 15 for Winter.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and not used in evaluation.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is NOT required nor is it used in the evaluation process.

gre_subject.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is NOT required nor is it used in the evaluation process.

supervisor.value: Applications are not processed without an Expression of Interest letter/email from a potential supervisor.
supervisor.quote: All applications to thesis-based programs will not be processed without the expression of interest from a potential Supervisor.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: The minimum is a four-year undergraduate degree with a 3.0 average in the last two years.
entry_route.quote: The Department’s minimum admission requirements are a four-year undergraduate degree with an average of 3.0 in the last two years

notes: Minimum GPA 3.0/4 over the last two years. Statement of purpose and three academic references.
